request.text: A small wooden airship salvage winch running steadily under load: low hand-built gear rotation, measured ratchet clicks and a rope sliding over a wooden pulley. Slow working mechanism, no completion clunk. Steady seamless looping game ambience, consistent texture at the start and end, no distinct beginning or ending, no large one-shot accents. No music, no speech, no crowd, no modern electronic siren.
